about.title: The person behind the commits
about.description:
I'm Anderson, a self-taught developer from Belo Horizonte, Brazil. I live mostly on the backend, where a bug isn't a crooked button, it's a wrong number in someone's balance. Since 2024 I've worked on payments at PicPay through Onebrain: first on Automatic Debit, now on the Payments Assistant (DDA) team, where I own several microservices in PHP, Hyperf and Go.

Before that, at Onfly, I migrated a PHP monolith to Hyperf microservices and built an in-house distributed transaction manager, so flight purchases, payments and internal balance commit or roll back together. Earlier, I co-founded two startups, Mediallize (an influencer marketplace that made the COTEMIG accelerator finals) and Borealis (a device-repair marketplace), and built a Laravel and React educational platform at Edutec where teachers create their own games.

Off the clock I run Arch Linux and write Rust for fun: a CLI that speaks my Dell G15's keyboard and fan USB protocol (reverse-engineered, now on the AUR) and a simulation that gives every person their own thread. I'm also a father, the best reason I know to write code that doesn't page anyone at 3 a.m.
